shape.situation_pattern: A long reasoner is about to start a heavy task and may re-derive or run stale processes.
shape.decision: Consult a sanity oracle against current+future state and coldest vertices before starting; surface its read once, then proceed.
shape.reasoning_physics: The cost of one check is small against the cost of executing on a stale or wrong map. One consult beats no consult; re-running stale plans wastes the deposit.
